LanguageData.APM_TerminusOverdrive.label: overdrive
LanguageData.APM_TerminusOverdrive.description: Terminus diverts power inward and briefly enters an overdriven combat state. While active, it sheds its cape, strikes harder, recovers between swings faster and becomes harder to stagger.

LanguageData.APM_TerminusOverdrive_Boss.description: Terminus diverts power inward and briefly enters an overdriven combat state. While active, it sheds its cape, strikes harder, recovers between swings faster and becomes harder to stagger.
LanguageData.APM_SeveringEdge.label: severing edge
LanguageData.APM_SeveringEdge.description: Utilizing the innate psychic channeling qualities of its blade, the caster releases a sweeping blade of energy in front of itself, cutting anything in the area.
